notes.title: UPDATE! VERSION 2
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just uploaded an update for Britannic!

Additions:    

-We added a dynamic sky instead of having a non-dynamic one (clouds now move etc)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36386668/c1903a90b96da676a485d09331c4274daac8dc83.png

-We added 2 horn blasts when the Britannic abandons ship

Fixes and tweaks:    

-The ship now sinks slightly faster

-We edited the colliders for the boats, ship and water so the game knows where you are better (in relation to the player so you don't get glitched)

-The ocean now generates more waves, making it look more realistic then before

-We fixed the pause menu

-Before the player camera couldn't see the island of Kea, this has now been fixed

Other:

Please leave a review if you are enjoying the game!

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Update R2! Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

This is the second update after release (hence R2). We have fixed many things!

Fixes:    

We have reduced player height slightly, as it could restrict you from entering certain areas of the ship

We have further tweaked when the lifeboat colliders activate to reduce the chances of the game thinking you are in one (and will therefore move you)

We have added colliders to the funnels so you can't enter them by climbing up them

We have made it so when you fall of the ship, it will eventually reload the main level not the main menu

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Update! New features!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just released a new update for Britannic! The changes are listed below.

New Additions:    

-New ladders at the back of the Britannic. There are 2 on each side. This will help you get back to the main boat deck instead of being stuck at the stern.

-New island. The island of Kea has been added, as it was near the Britannic when it sunk. The island is present in both modes, first person and free camera.

Other:

If you are enjoying the game please leave a review!

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: New effects and bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just released another update for Britannic adding new effects and fixing some bugs!

New Additions:    

We have added water splash effects when the Britannic hits the mine. This is in addition to the mine rocking the ship when it hits it.

Bug fixes:    

We have fixed the player slowly moving away from the Britannic when it is moving forward

We have changed how the lifeboats work with the colliders to reduce the chances of the game thinking the player is in a lifeboat when they are not

Interactive Gaming Studios

notes.title: Gameplay Improved!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have made improvements to the Britannic! Improvements are discussed below:

Improvements:    



Improved lifeboat stability when the player enters one. The player will now not shake as much

Lighting is much more stable as well. We have made it so that the lighting does not flicker, in addition to shadow improvements

Fixed lifeboat deployment animations for 2 lifeboats

Reduced engine sound



If you are excited for the Britannic remember to add it to your wishlist!

Interactive Gaming Studios
